summary: A Depth 20 subscribe: refused with the web adapter's words and status partial, nothing sent upstream; a Depth 5 subscribe after it streams the snapquote book.

notes: The web answers a Depth subscribe at any level but 5 with INVALID_DEPTH, "Invalid depth level 20. Must be 5", status partial (pocketful_adapter.py:256-259, websocket_proxy/server.py:1318-1334); the desktop refuses it at admission with the same words (feed/refusals.rs, lane life; PF-02).

deviations.reason: A snapquote carries no trade price (packet_decoder.py:83-137, averageTradePrice at 126); the web publishes its average trade price as ltp (pocketful_adapter.py:676), so a client reads the day's average as the last trade. The desktop sends the average as average_price and ltp from a real trade only: the last one known, or 0 before the instrument's first (the 1.0.6 rule for a book before any price). R107-07.
